first_attempt_end.basis: final result; no predicted_death cutoff recorded

limitations: 自有与外部独立分母；游戏版本自有未记录，保持unknown，不能称v0.111精确对照。
进阶分列；采用冻结外部模型回分，未再拟合或由开发定义流派。终局簇含结局信息。
自有结果是最终记录结果；SL重试/预判必死证据另分层，未见重试证据不等于证明未SL。首次尝试截止代理另记，不把最终牌组当首次失败牌组。
逐层/改牌快照是真实日志决策点；中间缺帧未知，首次记录到不等于实际首次获得。
战斗沿原logdb视图：first combat frame为首记录帧，未必动作前；SL同层可能合并尝试，触及战斗不据合并数据计算单次HP损失。
防御仅同一固定目录正block牌副本代理；间接防御、未知ID和历史版本对齐不补造。
外部前节点HP、还原时间线与自有逐层快照口径不完全等价；ordinal不是已核floor，不相减解释成晚几层。
关联与样本差异不证明因果；自有代码/大脑/学习版本演变、SL、玩家选择和幸存偏差保留。
question_scope: 原logdb抽取的题型/选项/选择/理由（可能已按原抽取器截长），不是全部原生prompt；off/len可定位冻结源行。

rows.archetype: Efficient early damage into flexible scaling and burst defense
rows.summary: Buy efficient damage and broadly useful support. Remove starters only after functional replacements. Take elites with adequate damage and resources; develop scaling from actual rewards rather than forcing a core.

rows.archetype: Poison-leaning control with efficient attacks and burst defense
rows.summary: Preserve nearby fires and take one supported elite, avoiding the riskier second. Upgrade Haze, add poison and block/draw, filter eternal curses, and remove Strikes after replacements. Body death still requires surviving the explosion.

rows.archetype: Poison control with dexterity, draw, and burst defense
rows.summary: Keep both fires and avoid further elites. Heal next; add efficient defense, draw, and poison acceleration. Upgrade Footwork only when health permits. Remove Strikes after replacements; preserve HP for the delayed explosion.

rows.archetype: Poison acceleration with dexterity-backed defense and draw
rows.summary: Boss damage gap is uncalibrated. Prioritize poison acceleration, efficient defense, and draw. Remove Strikes without stripping defensive coverage; avoid unsupported elites. The Giant’s death does not cancel its explosion.
